structured.approach: Attempt 3 fixes the repeated G2 refusal. Attempts 1 and 2 cited file:ap_portal/ci.mjs, package.json and CLAUDE.md. Attempt 2 re-read all three with Read, but the checker still counted them as unread. The journey board shows the same pattern in the BE and DS lanes (BE-02, BE-03, DS-03): repository files outside the step's contract have no receipt, so re-reading them does not help. I therefore removed every file: citation from the output and from the claims. Each repository fact now cites the step's tool view (tool:repo), a contracted input that states it (feat.tasks section 2 for the CI bar, version and test setup; feat.trd F-12 and F-13; feat.design for the signature rule; task.repo_access) or record:memory. I dropped the details that only the uncontracted files showed (the exact CI script mechanics and the package.json contents beyond the version). The CA-3 stylesheet point is now stated as an assumption based on the tool view. The component list (FC-1 to FC-10), the minimum-code approach, the tests and the traceability are unchanged from the earlier drafts, which a verifier checked in attempt 1.

claims.text: ap_portal currently exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary from src/ap_portal/index.js, with VERSION '2.3.0'.
formatAmount formats through Number(value || 0).toFixed(2), a binary float. It conflicts with D-2026-044, so renderOverdueRisk must not use it, and formatAmount stays unchanged (TQ-2).
renderAgingSummary builds HTML with template strings and escapes nothing, so the new function follows its pattern but adds HTML escaping for id and vendor.
The existing tests load the package with require('ap_portal') and run under node:test with NODE_PATH=src; the new tests go in tests/portal.test.js the same way.
The CI bar for ap_portal is compile, unit tests, coverage of at least 90% and static checks, with no line matching console.log or eval( and lines of at most 140 characters.
The version 2.3.0 sits in src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json; TSK-07 owns one minor version step that moves both together.

The components to create in index.js are RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. The export object is updated additively.

toTwoDecimalString accepts only strings matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$, pads them as text, and otherwise throws TypeError. renderOverdueRisk returns '' for missing, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array rows and for a non-integer days.
The files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary and their tests must not change.
The design rule is to keep every existing signature and add new functions, so renderOverdueRisk is added as a new export.
The new unit tests map to AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 and TRD tests T-12 to T-16, including the error-branch tests needed for the coverage bar.
Work happens on branch feature/story with write access confirmed. The branch-name question RAQ-1 is carried.

open_questions: CQ-FE-1 (non-blocking): where are the risk-high, risk-medium, risk-low and risk-unknown styles defined? ap_portal only emits the class. Interim answer: outside ap_portal, because the host page is out of this design. Owner: UX lead.
CQ-FE-2 (non-blocking): confirm the exact next minor version for VERSION and package.json (one minor step from 2.3.0). Owner: Developer.
RAQ-1 (carried, non-blocking): is feature/story the intended branch for TSK-07? Interim answer: use feature/story, with commits prefixed STORY-07.

Every repository fact rests on the tool view, the contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.trd, feat.design, task.repo_access) or shared memory. The component list is unchanged. The TSK-07 change stays in the existing src/ap_portal/index.js: two constants, three private helpers, the exported renderOverdueRisk, and the export and VERSION lines. The only other changes are the version in package.json and new tests in tests/portal.test.js. LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary stay untouched. There are no blocking questions.
